title: Probabilistic Multi-Source Data Selection via Learnable Categorical Priors: Variance Reduction and Guaranteed Derandomization
abstract: arXiv:2610.14942v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Bilevel data selection is a fundamental task with numerous applications in machine learning and statistics. A common strategy for tackling this problem is to relax the original bilevel combinatorial optimization into a continuous one. However, existing methods, including 0-1 relaxation and probabilistic relaxation, still suffer from several limitations, such as unstable gradient estimation and infeasible rounding. To address these issues, this paper proposes a new probabilistic relaxation for the multi-source bilevel data selection problem. translated_title: 基于可学习类别先验的概率多源数据选择：方差缩减与有保证的去随机化
translated_abstract: 双层数据选择是一项基础性任务，在机器学习和统计学中有着众多应用。解决该问题的一种常见策略是将原始的双层组合优化松弛为连续优化问题。然而，现有方法（包括0-1松弛和概率松弛）仍然存在若干局限性，例如梯度估计不稳定和舍入不可行。为解决这些问题，本文针对多源双层数据选择问题提出了一种新的概率松弛方法。我们的核心思想是引入多个可学习的类别先验来参数化一个仅支撑于可行数据子集上的概率分布，从而自然地产生一种无损舍入方案。我们进一步证明，所提出的松弛方法允许一种有效的两点梯度估计器，它能够同时避免现有0-1松弛所需的逆Hessian计算以及……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种基于可学习类别先验的新型概率松弛方法来解决多源双层数据选择问题，通过仅支撑于可行数据子集的概率分布实现无损舍入，并借助两点梯度估计器同时实现方差缩减和有保证的去随机化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a new probabilistic relaxation for multi-source bilevel data selection via learnable categorical priors, which parameterizes a distribution supported only on feasible data subsets to enable lossless rounding, and employs a two-point gradient estimator to simultaneously achieve variance reduction and guaranteed derandomization.
